chunks.text:
[Intro]
{solo komuz alone, galloping finger strokes, no voice}
positive_styles: solo Kyrgyz komuz, the old Turkic kopuz lute, three gut strings, fretless long neck, small carved apricot-wood body
bare right hand: nail down-strokes, fingertip up-strokes, brushed and flicked, no pick
unbroken galloping ostinato on every eighth note, 6/8, dotted quarter 52 BPM, 156 strokes per minute
open D and A strings drone under a one-string melody, the melody moves constantly
short dry woody decay, each stroke dies within a second, nail click and finger noise clearly audible
quick knuckle taps on the wooden body between phrases
D dorian, natural F, natural C
Central Asian nomad epic song accompaniment
close-mic'd inside a felt tent, bone-dry, one player, no room sound
instrumental

solo old male epic bard who sings and plays at the same time, the komuz never stops under the voice
raw strained chest voice with a guttural raspy throat edge, unpolished, no warmth
syllabic chant on few notes, one note per syllable, then a long last note falling to D
each line descends A, G, F, D before its last words
straight tone, only a short shake on the final note
